description: This file implements thread pool and task worker pool classes for managing worker threads, including task creation, thread synchronization, and stopping mechanisms, specifically for the 'ocudu' project.

classes.name: detail::base_worker_pool
classes.description: Base class managing a pool of worker threads, handling thread creation, CPU affinity, and thread pool membership checks.

classes.name: priority_task_worker_pool
classes.description: Derived class managing a prioritized task worker pool with stop and wait functionalities.

classes.name: task_worker_pool
classes.description: Template class managing a pool of worker threads with different queue policies, including stopping and waiting for tasks.

methods.name: worker_task_factory
methods.description: Creates a worker task function that sets execution context and processes jobs from a queue.

methods.name: base_worker_pool::base_worker_pool
methods.description: Constructor initializing worker threads with optional CPU affinity masks.

methods.name: base_worker_pool::is_in_thread_pool
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is part of the worker thread pool.

methods.name: priority_task_worker_pool::wait_pending_tasks
methods.description: Waits until all pending tasks are completed and workers are synchronized.

methods.name: task_worker_pool::wait_pending_tasks
methods.description: Waits until all pending tasks are completed and workers are synchronized.
